text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses artificial neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. AI is already part of our daily lives. For example, it powers voice assistants on our phones, suggests films on streaming platforms, and helps doctors diagnose diseases more accurately. AI is changing the way we live and work.
